loss: Sum valid next-token cross-entropies / 8176 nominal target slots, including short pulse batches
precision: FP32 weights/optimizer; BF16 autocast; deterministic SDPA; TF32 disabled
schedule: Constant rate. Both branches restore model, optimizer, RNG and data cursor from shared step 150 before setting their own rate.
shared_stability_gate: Stop before pulses if fixed development NLL at shared step 150 is >1.02 times initial NLL; improvements are allowed.
branch_stability_gate: Stop that branch before pulses if fixed development NLL at branch step 200 is >1.02 times shared step 150 NLL; report as instability, not rare-word weak learning.
x_star: One common own-target shift anchor at shared step 150; 5% of currently wrong unique directional full-sentence comparisons; summed LL; strict >; 1e-6 margin; cap at zero log-probability. Not a guarantee of actual repairs.
G1: Mean over matched pairs of treated-minus-control changes from each word's e-1 baseline to mean e+10 through e+50 context score; context=mean two own-minus-partner target-logprob sums
uncertainty: 10,000 matched-pair bootstrap resamples, fixed seed 2026110608; unadjusted percentile 95% interval; event-cluster and flagged-source-exclusion sensitivities are secondary
advance_gate: Lower bound of G1 CI > 0. This notebook never launches Stage B automatically.
weak_gain_gate: If advance gate fails and upper G1 CI < x*, report no meaningful positive persistent contextual gain at declared bar; otherwise inconclusive. Not proof of nothing learned.
source_quality_sensitivity: Keep all 400 words primary. Secondary excludes any matched pair containing one of the 27 pre-flagged residual encoding/spaced-numeral excerpts.
scientific_scope: Controlled continuation with a fresh optimizer, not recovery of original historical training order. No novelty or broad vocabulary-learning claim.
